title: What Happens When You Hit Your Funny Bone?
description:
Send this to the friend who walks into every door frame.
Your funny bone isn't a bone: it's your ulnar nerve, which runs from your neck to your hand and sits just under the skin at your elbow with very little tissue to protect it (Cleveland Clinic, AAOS OrthoInfo). One bump pinches it, and the shock-like tingle shoots into your pinky and half your ring finger. If numbness or tingling in those fingers lasts more than six weeks or is severe, see a doctor (Cleveland Clinic, AAOS).
